summary: Added programs.sapience.sessionClassifier, exporting the vendor's NO_CLASSIFY=1 switch, wired into both sapience module trees (dotfiles module default false, published packages/sapience-flake default true), with a classifier-aware progress ticker in both. Applied the change live via home-manager switch and recorded the measured per-pass cost shape (classifier dominates roughly the first 20 of 29 minutes per pass; the backlog holds flat at 136 and does not drain) in docs/sapience.md as settled fact. The complete repository gate set was deferred to the batch stage per this dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive; the scoped verify-touched.sh discharge returned one suite better than the recorded baseline.
